name: The Broken Chain
description: File hash matches known malware (47/70 on VirusTotal). But no acquisition record exists, no examiner signature, and the provenance chain has no root. Under Daubert, the evidence is inadmissible.

artifacts.description: SHA-256 matches known malware. VirusTotal: 47/70 detections. BUT there's no acquisition record and no chain root. No markers set: the engine's detector suite has no provenance category — inadmissibility here comes entirely from custodyEvents being empty, not from a fired detector.
artifacts.description_es: SHA-256 coincide con malware conocido. VirusTotal: 47/70 detecciones. PERO no hay registro de adquisición ni chain root.

artifacts.description: Creation timestamp matches a known beacon interval. But the chain of custody has a single orphaned hash, with no parent disk image.
artifacts.description_es: Timestamp de creación coincide con intervalo de beacon conocido. Pero la cadena de custodia tiene un solo hash huérfano, sin imagen de disco padre.

peirce_chain.firstness: 47/70 detections on VirusTotal — apparently strong signal.
peirce_chain.secondness: No acquisition record, no examiner signature, no root for the chain of custody.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Without a root of trust it can't be verified that the evidence wasn't planted or modified. Inadmissible.

demo_quote: High-quality evidence without a chain of custody is inadmissible. VELO doesn't get seduced by the hash; it demands provenance. `PROVENANCE_BREAK` here is narrative documentation, not a detector fracture — score() short-circuits to ABSTAIN as soon as custodyEvents is empty, before any of the 5 detectors run.
description_es: Hash de archivo coincide con malware conocido (47/70 en VirusTotal). Pero no existe registro de adquisición, no hay firma del perito y la cadena de provenance no tiene raíz. Bajo Daubert, la evidencia es inadmisible.
demo_quote_es: Evidencia de alta calidad sin cadena de custodia es inadmisible. VELO no se deja seducir por el hash; exige provenance.

peirce_chain_es.firstness: 47/70 detecciones en VirusTotal — señal aparentemente fuerte.
peirce_chain_es.secondness: No hay acquisition record, firma de perito, ni root de la cadena de custodia.
peirce_chain_es.thirdness: Sin root of trust no se puede verificar que la evidencia no fue plantada o modificada. Inadmisible.
